commun.devise: Peace – Work – Fatherland · Paix – Travail – Patrie
auth.sousAccroche: Ministry of Higher Education · drafting, approval workflow, signature and archiving of acts, in one place.
auth.sousTitre: Use your staff number or your work e-mail address.
auth.essaisRestants: {n} attempt(s) left before the account is locked for 15 minutes.
auth.aide: Access problem? Contact the Information Systems Division.
auth.sessionExpiree: Your session expired after 30 minutes of inactivity. Please sign in again.
mfa.consigne: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
enrolement.consigne: Required for your role. Use an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, FreeOTP).
enrolement.etape1: Scan the QR code with the app.
enrolement.etape3: Enter the generated code to confirm
secours.consigne: Each can be used only once. Keep them safe: they will not be shown again.
secours.continuer: I have saved my codes, continue
verrou.texte: Too many attempts failed. For security, access is suspended.
verrou.prevenir: Wasn't you? Notify the IT division: the event has been logged.
reinit.consigne: We will send a link valid for 30 minutes to the address linked to your account.
reinit.envoyeTexte: If an account matches, a link has been sent{a}. It expires in 30 minutes and works only once.
reinit.regleMajChiffre: One uppercase letter and one digit
reinit.succes: Password saved. All your sessions have been closed.
reinit.expireTitre: This link is no longer valid
reinit.expireTexte: It has expired (30 minutes) or has already been used. Request a new one.
monTravail.prochainement: The “To sign” counter will be fed once signing (M06) is delivered.
inactivite.texte: Your session will close in {t} due to inactivity.
mesActes.sousTitre: Drafts you have written, from first draft to archiving.
mesActes.soumis: Draft submitted: it is now in the first approver's signature book.
nouvel.question: Which act do you want to draft?
nouvel.sansCircuit: No workflow configured for your unit
nouvel.cache: Templates served from cache (synchronised on {d}). The GitHub repository is unreachable; you can carry on as usual.
nouvel.prerempli: Pre-filled: official header, statutory citations, copy list (BF-16).
nouvel.sansModeleDesc: Official header only, no pre-filled text.
type.desc.NS: Internal measure, short workflow, internal circulation.
type.desc.D: Individual act: posting, leave, authorisation. Notified to the person concerned.
type.desc.AM: Regulatory or individual. Legal review and possible translation.
type.desc.CIR: Guidance addressed to departments and institutions.
type.desc.ATT: Assumption of duty, effective presence. Handed to the requesting officer.
type.desc.DEC: Prepared here, then sent to the Presidency or the Prime Minister's services.
editeur.objetAide: For example “on the end-of-year leave calendar”.
editeur.traduction: Translation required (adds the Translation Unit step)
conf.aide.PUBLIC: Public: may be published; content shown on the verification page.
conf.aide.INTERNE: Internal: visible to ministry staff according to their rights.
conf.aide.CONFIDENTIEL: Confidential: visible only to the workflow and authorised roles; every view is logged.
editeur.conflit: This draft was changed elsewhere (another tab?). Reload it before continuing.
editeur.lectureSeule: This draft is in the approval workflow: it can no longer be edited.
pieces.formats: PDF, DOCX, JPG, PNG · 20 MB max.
pieces.tropGros: Refused: {n} MB exceeds the 20 MB limit
pieces.format: Format not accepted (PDF, DOCX, JPG, PNG)
champ.ampliation: At least one recipient in the copy list
soumission.texte: The draft will no longer be editable unless an approver sends it back for correction.
supprimer.texte: “{objet}” and its {n} attachment(s) will be permanently deleted.
erreur.RESEAU: The EACT server is not responding. Check your connection; unsaved input stays on the page.
erreur.ERREUR_INTERNE: Internal server error. If it happens again, report it to IT with reference {ref}.
erreur.SESSION_EXPIREE: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
erreur.ACCES_REFUSE: You are not allowed to do this.
erreur.INTROUVABLE: Item not found: it may have been deleted.
erreur.TROP_DE_REQUETES: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
toast.soumis: Draft submitted to the approval workflow.
parapheur.sousTitre: {n} act(s) awaiting your approval · sorted by due date
visa.derniereEtape: Last approval: the act will be ready to sign.
rejet.avertissement: The draft will leave the workflow and can no longer be edited. For a simple fix, use “Request a correction” instead.
fiche.redacteur: You drafted this act. You can follow its workflow but neither approve nor sign it (RG-19).
fiche.dejaVise: You already approved this step on {d} (RG-18).
fiche.pasVotreEtape: The act is awaiting someone else's approval: {e}.
fiche.piecesEnAnalyse: Attachment being scanned: approval will be possible once all attachments are available (RG-24).
fiche.horsCircuit: This act is no longer in the approval workflow.
fiche.interim: Acting: you approve on behalf of {nom}. The approval will bear the mention “{mention}”.
c9.retour: After resubmission, the workflow resumes at the first approval.
aCompleter.auto: The draft saves itself as you type. “Submit” sends it to the first approver, which requires:
aCompleter.objetOu: in the document title or the “Details” panel
aCompleter.contenuOu: in the body of the document
signature.vide: No act to sign for now.
signature.info2: The reference is assigned at that moment, with no duplicate or gap.
signature.info4: The final PDF/A is produced with a verification QR and fingerprint.
signature.info5: The act becomes final: any correction will require a corrective act.
signature.consigne: {objet}. Enter the code shown in your app.
signature.codeIncorrect: Incorrect code. The act was not signed.
signature.neFermezPas: Do not close this window. If the connection drops, signing will resume without assigning a second number.
signature.diffusion: The drafter has been notified by e-mail.
signature.qrImprime: Verification QR printed on the act
signature.dejaSigne: This act is already signed. Your request had succeeded before the drop: no new number was assigned.
signature.nonCompetent: This act awaits the signature of: {s}.
verif.sousTitre: Enter the short code printed under the act's QR code (e.g. K7Q2-9M).
verif.retireTexte: This act existed but is no longer in force.
verif.introuvableTexte: Check your input. A document whose code cannot be found was not issued by the ministry.
verif.objetMasque: The content of this act is not public.
verif.comparerTitre: Compare your PDF with the original
verif.comparerTexte: Drop the PDF you received: its fingerprint is computed and compared with the signed document.
verif.identique: Document identical to the signed original.
verif.different: This document has been altered: it does not match the signed original.
verif.pied: Public verification service for acts of the Ministry of Higher Education. No personal data is kept.
demo.aide: Sign in directly, or pre-fill the form (password: {mdp}) to show the normal flow. Verification codes are shown on screen: no phone needed.
